categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: aviation engines and derivative products, foreign trade export subcontracting, and non-aviation products and other businesses. It manufactures, sells, and services aviation engines and gas turbines, provides maintenance and repair services, and produces aviation engine components for export. The company also develops high value-added products related to aviation engine technology, such as process equipment and industrial properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in aviation engine design, manufacturing, assembly, testing, and maintenance, covering the full lifecycle of products. It focuses on key core technologies including additive manufacturing, coating technologies, advanced materials application, and precision high-efficiency machining. The company has established a comprehensive R&D system with national-level labs and innovation centers, and applies digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military aviation sectors, commercial aviation manufacturers, and international aerospace companies such as SAFRAN, Rolls-Royce, GE Aerospace, and others. The company serves military aircraft, commercial aircraft, and industrial gas turbine markets. It is a major supplier for Chinese military aircraft and a core component supplier for domestic commercial aircraft engines, also expanding into general aviation and low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Shaanxi, Liaoning, Hunan, Guizhou, and other provinces. It also engages in international markets through export subcontracting and cooperation with global aerospace firms. Domestic sales dominate revenue, with growing overseas sales linked to export subcontracting business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the full aviation engine supply chain, including research and development, manufacturing, assembly, testing, sales, and after-sales service. It is positioned midstream to downstream, producing complete engines and components, providing maintenance and repair services, and engaging in export subcontracting of engine parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the development and batch production of new generation aviation engines, expanding domestic commercial and general aviation markets, and enhancing international cooperation. R&D focuses on key core technologies, digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and green development. The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, talent development, and building a robust supply chain with risk-sharing partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of aviation engines and components, subcontracted manufacturing services for international clients, and after-sales maintenance and repair services. The company also earns income from non-aviation product sales and government subsidies. Revenue recognition follows contract fulfillment and transfer of control principles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the only domestic enterprise capable of independently developing a full spectrum of military aviation engines and is among a few globally with such capability. It holds a leading position in China's aviation engine industry, with strong technical advantages and strategic partnerships internationally. Competitors include major global aerospace engine manufacturers, but the company benefits from stable military demand and growing commercial aviation markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 47.88 billion, a 9.48% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 860 million, a decrease of 39.48%. Total assets reached RMB 115.91 billion, up 16.15%. The company has a large workforce exceeding 30,000 employees, with significant R&D investment totaling over RMB 1 billion. Despite profit decline due to increased R&D and financial expenses, the company maintains a strong asset base and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive capability to develop and produce a full range of military aviation engines, a unique position domestically and internationally. It offers differentiated value through full lifecycle services, advanced manufacturing technologies, and a robust innovation ecosystem. Its products support national strategic security and meet high-performance requirements for military and commercial aviation, with expanding presence in emerging markets like general aviation and low-altitude economy.
